SELECT ?zone ?name ?sensor ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; brick:hasName ?name .
  ?sensor brick:hasInputSignal ?zone ; a brick:ElectricPowerSensor .
  ?point ref:hasExternalReference ?sensor .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
}

SELECT ?zone ?name ?sensor ?tsid WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; rdfs:label ?name .
  ?sensor a brick:ElectricPowerSensor .
  ?sensor brick:hasInputSignal ?zone .
  ?ref ref:hasTimeseriesId ?tsid .
  ?ref ref:hasExternalReference ?sensor .
}

data = open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
import re
# find all electric power sensors
for m in re.finditer(r'bldg:([A-Za-z0-9_]+Electric_Power_Sensor) a [^\n]+', data):
    print(m.group(0))

data = open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
import re
# find all HVAC_Zone with label + zoneType
blocks = re.findall(r'bldg:(Zone_\w+) a brick:HVAC_Zone ;\n(?:[^\n]*\n){10}', data)
for uri in re.findall(r'bldg:(Zone_[A-Za-z0-9_]+) a brick:HVAC_Zone', data):
    i = data.find(f"bldg:{uri} a brick:HVAC_Zone")
    seg = data[i:i+600]
    lab = re.search(r'rdfs:label "([^"]+)"', seg)
    zt = re.search(r'zoneType "([^"]+)"', seg)
    sp = re.search(r'spatialLocation "([^"]+)"', seg)
    print(uri, lab.group(1) if lab else None, zt.group(1) if zt else None, sp.group(1) if sp else None)
